articles.title: Ganymede's Magnetic Mystery: A 'Warming-Driven Dynamo' Could Rewrite Moon Formation
articles.summary: Jupiter's moon Ganymede is the only moon with its own magnetic field. A new study proposes it's heating up from the inside—a process never seen before—which could explain how its metallic core formed late and still powers a dynamo today.

articles.title: Venus' Coronae: 3D Maps Reveal a Planet More Active Than We Knew
articles.summary: New 3D models of Venus' largest coronae—giant circular fracture systems—suggest warm mantle upwellings beneath 52 of them. This is the strongest evidence yet that plume-related tectonic processes are active on our twin planet.

articles.title: London International Finals: Wiffen, Moesch, and Tribuntsov Headline Electric Closing Session
articles.summary: The 2026 AP Race London International concludes tonight at the London Aquatic Centre. Olympic champion Daniel Wiffen faces a German distance trio, while Anna Moesch and Ralf Tribuntsov look to cap dominant meets with more gold.
